program: LEVI Boot Camp — 30-day, 24/7 defensive analyst, platform intelligence, and LEVI domain mastery program

track_boundaries.A: Defensive-only. Detection, analysis, hardening. No offensive instruction content, ever.
track_boundaries.B: Public sources only. Original LEVI synthesis, never copied text.
track_boundaries.C: Operate LEVI's own systems. Advisory-only where money or publishing is involved.
track_boundaries.S: Cross-track practicals. Inherits the strictest boundary of every track involved (defensive-only for security content).

weeks.note: Core vocabulary and mental models. Every later lesson assumes this week's concepts; the runner reads the journal so teaching compounds instead of repeating.
Working methods: engineering detections, tuning, hunting with structure, consuming intel, operating LEVI's subsystems for real.
Harder, longer-horizon work: advanced hunts, DFIR, cross-domain orchestration, platform teardowns with investment-grade depth.
Capstones, war-games, and honest self-assessment. Ends with Session 120: cross-track graduation assessment and a brain retrain.
